findings.notes: The newly opened combat phase sheets and four closeups show closed fists and attached wrists without prior long waist-to-elbow blades. Selected gait front/back/side/hip frames keep pelvis and legs connected.

Thumbs oppose outside the folded fingers; jab/cross/hook use knuckle-oriented fists and face-height opposite guard. Ordered selected phases return through guard to neutral. All four hand closeup files are byte-identical to prior reviewed originals.
Standing fighting shoes appear supported and walk/run poses differ with alternating recovery leg lift. Static sheets cannot establish sole velocity, continuous timing or subjective naturalness.

Raised-arm images retain small jagged sleeve/torso gaps and sharp garment strips. Bare wrists show an authored seam; female waist has a hard transition. These are not seamless production-quality surfaces.
Hands remain flat/open and appear palm-up in selected running side views. The pose is less natural than relaxed human running hands.
Face, eyelids, hair, fingers and skin are simplified. This review does not support photorealism, completed human realism or GTA/Sims production asset quality.

scope: Frozen integrated release static/native visual review and source/asset identity audit. Does not establish all city OS controls, subjective moving-combat timing, camera comfort, police pursuit behavior, runtime performance, all camera scales or completed realistic character art.
